This page lists 149 Adobe After Effects keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `after-effects.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Adobe After Effects to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t after-effects.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/after-effects.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Adobe After Effects 2024/Adobe After Effects 2024.app`; if Adobe After Effects lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## General

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘A` | Select all |
| `F2` | Deselect all |
| `⌘⇧A` | Deselect all (alt) |
| `⌘D` | Duplicate |
| `⌘Z` | Undo |
| `⌘⇧Z` | Redo |
| `⌘Q` | Quit |
| `⌥⌘/` | Purge All Memory |

## Projects

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥⌘N` | New project |
| `⌘O` | Open project |
| `⌥⇧⌘P` | Open most recent project |
| `⌥⇧⌘N` | New folder in Project panel |
| `⌥⇧⌘K` | Project Settings |
| `⌘F` | Find in Project panel |

## Time Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥⇧J` | Go to specific time |
| `⇧Home` | Go to work area start |
| `⇧End` | Go to work area end |
| `J` | Previous keyframe/marker |
| `K` | Next keyframe/marker |
| `Home` | Go to beginning |
| `End` | Go to end |
| `⇟` | Go forward 1 frame |
| `⌘→` | Go forward 1 frame (alt) |
| `⇞` | Go backward 1 frame |
| `⌘←` | Go backward 1 frame (alt) |
| `⇧⇟` | Go forward 10 frames |
| `⇧⇞` | Go backward 10 frames |
| `I` | Go to layer In point |
| `O` | Go to layer Out point |
| `D` | Scroll to current time |

## Template file

The full [`after-effects.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/after-effects.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
